newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Graphics to buy Mobility Inc.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Graphics to buy Mobility Inc.

text.p: Consolidated Graphics Inc said Friday it is signing a letter of intent to buy Mobility Inc in Richmond, Virginia, for undisclosed terms.
The purchase is Consolidated's first entry into the Mid-Atlantic region and its fourth announced acquisition since the beginning of its fiscal year in April, Consolidated said.
The company added that total annual revenues from the four companies exceeds $34 million. Mobility had 1995 revenues of $6 million, Consolidated said.
